# Remove-ZbxTag

## SYNOPSIS

Removes a tag from hosts and keeps their other tags.

## SYNTAX

### ByName (Default)

```
Remove-ZbxTag [-Name] <string> [[-Value] <string>] [-Force] -InputObject <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByTag

```
Remove-ZbxTag [-Force] -InputObject <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> -Tag <ZabbixTagRequest[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Remove-ZbxTag cmdlet reads the current tags of the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts), takes out every tag named -Name, or only the one with -Value, and writes the rest back with host.update, so the other tags stay. Every host the pipeline brings is changed in one call. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false is given, and writes the hosts only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Remove a tag from a host

```powershell
Remove-ZbxTag -InputObject 'web-01' -Name 'team' -Confirm:$false -PassThru | ForEach-Object Tags | Select-Object Tag, Value
```

Every tag named team goes, whatever its value; the host's other tags stay. Removing asks for a confirmation even at ConfirmImpact Medium, so a script passes -Confirm:$false (or -Force). -PassThru writes the updated host.

### Example 2: Remove only one value of a tag

```powershell
Remove-ZbxTag 'team' 'checkout' -InputObject 'web-01' -Confirm:$false
(Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01' -SelectTags).Tags | Select-Object Tag, Value
```

With -Value, only the tag with that exact name and value is removed.

### Example 3: Remove a tag from every host of a group, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Web servers' | Remove-ZbxTag -Name 'env' -WhatIf
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Web servers' | Remove-ZbxTag -Name 'env' -Confirm:$false
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Web servers' -SelectTags | Select-Object TechnicalName, @{ n = 'TagCount'; e = { @($_.Tags).Count } }
```

Get-ZbxHost writes host objects; Remove-ZbxTag binds each one. Hosts without the tag are left as they are.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Value (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixTagRequest[]`: Bound to -Tag (ByValue). A tag to set on an object: a name with an optional value, such as env=prod.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixHost`: Represents a Zabbix host object.
